entities.name: Phyrexian Negator
entities.description: One of Phyrexia's most notorious creations, made to track and destroy planeswalkers.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker whom Phyrexia tried to destroy using negators before the Invasion.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Site of a Phyrexian attack in which negators were the chief operatives.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which negators were used very scarcely.

events.summary: Negators were the chief operatives during the Phyrexian attack on the original Tolarian Academy.
events.quote: Negators were the chief operatives during the Phyrexian attack on the original Tolarian Academy

relations.note: Created for tracking and destroying planeswalkers.
relations.quote: Negators were created for the sole purpose of tracking and destroying planeswalkers

relations.note: Used in attempts to destroy Urza.
relations.quote: later chiefly used in Phyrexia's attempts to destroy Urza
